questions.question: A company offers three types of successive discounts: First offer: 25% and 5%, Second offer: 20% and 10%, Third offer: 15% and 15%. Which offer is the best for a customer?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the sum of successive discounts is constant (25+5 = 30, 20+10 = 30, 15+15 = 30), the discount is maximum when the difference between the two values is maximum.

Difference in First offer: |25 − 5| = 20

Difference in Second offer: |20 − 10| = 10

Difference in Third offer: |15 − 15| = 0

Since the difference is maximum in the First offer, it provides the highest discount for the customer.

**∴ The correct answer is First offer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Offer 1: 25% and 5% | Offer 2: 20% and 10% | Offer 3: 15% and 15%

Formula for equivalent single discount of two successive discounts a% and b% = [a + b − (a × b)/100]%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eadaaa2eb58223c44c37b804a0654a8261b265a1ca730a4e136f5eda2d88a0bb.png] 

⇒ Equivalent Discount for First offer = 25 + 5 − (25 × 5)/100 = 30 − 1.25 = 28.75%

⇒ Equivalent Discount for Second offer = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10)/100 = 30 − 2 = 28.00%

⇒ Equivalent Discount for Third offer = 15 + 15 − (15 × 15)/100 = 30 − 2.25 = 27.75%

⇒ Comparing the three values: 28.75% > 28.00% > 27.75%

**∴ The correct answer is First offer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts x% and y%, the net discount is (x + y − xy/100)%. For three discounts, calculate the first two and then apply the result with the third one.

Customer vs Retailer Perspective

The best offer for a customer is the one with the highest net discount percentage, whereas the best offer for a retailer is the one with the lowest net discount percentage.

Relationship with Product of Discounts

When the sum (x+y) is constant, the discount is maximum when the product (xy) is minimum. In this question, 25 × 5 = 125 is the minimum product compared to 200 and 225.</p

questions.question: Four horses are tethered with a rope, half of the length of the side, at four corners of a square field of side 28m. What will be the area of the ungrazed part of the field?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of ungrazed part = Area of Square − Area of one full circle (as 4 quadrants of 90° form 1 circle).

Side of square (s) = 28 m, Radius of circle (r) = s ÷ 2 = 14 m.

Ungrazed Area = s² − πr²

Ungrazed Area = 28² − (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14

Ungrazed Area = 784 − 616 = 168 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 168 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the square field (s) = 28 m

Length of the rope (radius, r) = 28 ÷ 2 = 14 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = side × side

Area of quadrant = (1 ÷ 4) × π × r²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/446777655046b62a3f8582e6dfc7de009d8214b9885779462b7be23510973849.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Area of the square field = 28 × 28 = 784 m²

⇒ Total Area grazed by 4 horses = 4 × Area of one quadrant

⇒ Grazed Area = 4 × (1 ÷ 4) × (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14

⇒ Grazed Area = (22 ÷ 7) × 196

⇒ Grazed Area = 22 × 28 = 616 m²

⇒ Ungrazed Part = Total Area − Grazed Area

⇒ Ungrazed Part = 784 − 616 = 168 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 168 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Square

The total space occupied by a square is given by Area = side × side (or s²).

Area of Circle and Sector

Area of a circle is πr². For a sector with angle θ, the area is (θ ÷ 360) × πr². Since square corners are 90°, each sector is exactly 1 ÷ 4 of a circle.

Combined Quadrant Rule

When four equal circles are drawn at the four corners of a square such that each touches two others, the radius is always half the side of the square.</p

questions.question: 4 × √{1296} + 4 × √{2116} + 4 × √{6561} - 10 × √{1225} = k. Then find the value of 'k'?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4 times sqrt{1296} + 4 times sqrt{2116} + 4 times sqrt{6561} - 10 times sqrt{1225} = k

**Formula used:**

sqrt{1296} = 36, sqrt{2116} = 46, sqrt{6561} = 81, sqrt{1225} = 35

**Calculation:**

k = 4 times 36 + 4 times 46 + 4 times 81 - 10 times 35

⇒ k = 4 times (36 + 46 + 81) - 350

⇒ k = 4 times 163 - 350

⇒ k = 652 - 350

⇒ k = 302

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: In a competitive examination held in the year 2000, a total of 6,00,000 (6.0 lakh) students appeared and 40% passed the examination. Forty percent (40%) of the total students. were females and the rest were males. The pass percentage among the males was 50%. Find the pass percentage among the females.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Males to Females = 60% : 40% = 3 : 2

Let the pass percentage among females be x%

Using Weighted Average: Total Pass % = (Male % × Male Pass % + Female % × Female Pass %) ÷ 100

40 = (60 × 50 + 40 × x) ÷ 100

4000 = 3000 + 40x ⇒ 40x = 1000 ⇒ x = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Total students = 6,00,000

Total pass percentage = 40%

Female percentage = 40%

Male pass percentage = 50%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e3ad1d65fbb71716cceba5ff499f5ad711badf6978bf08aa8b87eeb7666900c.png] 

⇒ Total passed students = 40% of 6,00,000 = (40 ÷ 100) × 6,00,000 = 2,40,000

⇒ Number of females = 40% of 6,00,000 = 2,40,000

⇒ Number of males = Total − Females = 6,00,000 − 2,40,000 = 3,60,000

⇒ Number of males passed = 50% of 3,60,000 = (50 ÷ 100) × 3,60,000 = 1,80,000

⇒ Number of females passed = Total passed − Males passed = 2,40,000 − 1,80,000 = 60,000

⇒ Pass percentage among females = (Females passed ÷ Total females) × 100

⇒ Pass percentage among females = (60,000 ÷ 2,40,000) × 100 = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Rule

When a population is divided into two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂, the total average Aₐvg = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Percentage Base Change

The value of a percentage depends entirely on the base it is calculated on. In this problem, the female pass percentage is calculated on the total number of females, not the total population.

Alligation Method

Alligation can be used to find the ratio of quantities or individual percentages. Ratio of M:F = (Total% − Female%) : (Male% − Total%).</p

questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years 4 months, compound annually.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Rate for 2 years = 15% p.a.; Rate for remaining 4 months = 15% × 4/12 = 5%.

Successive Multiplier Ratio: (20 → 23) × (20 → 23) × (20 → 21).

Total Principal Ratio = 20 × 20 × 20 = 8000 units.

Total Amount Ratio = 23 × 23 × 21 = 11109 units.

Compound Interest = 11109 − 8000 = 3109 units.

Given Principal = Rs 8000 ∴ 1 unit = Rs 1; CI = 3109 × 1 = Rs 3109.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs 3109.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs 8000

Rate (R) = 15% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years 4 months = 2¹/₃ years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ × [1 + (R × t/12)/100]

Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c34f7eb8c5996e08362ed16ee34a2cbe55f1ab5295aeaaed9aac66be06c366a2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time = 2 years + 4/12 years = 2 years + 1/3 years

⇒ Amount = 8000 × (1 + 15/100)² × [1 + (15 × 1/3)/100]

⇒ Amount = 8000 × (115/100) × (115/100) × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ Amount = 8000 × (23/20) × (23/20) × (21/20)

⇒ Amount = 8000 × (529/400) × (21/20)

⇒ Amount = 8000 × (11109/8000)

⇒ Amount = Rs 11109

⇒ CI = Amount − Principal

⇒ CI = 11109 − 8000

⇒ CI = Rs 3109

**∴ The correct answer is Rs 3109.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest for Fractional Years

When time is in the form a b/c years, Amount = P(1 + R/100)a × [1 + (R × b/c)/100].

Effective Rate of Interest

For two successive years with rates R₁ and R₂, the effective CI rate is R₁ + R₂ + (R₁ × R₂)/100.

CI vs SI Difference

The difference between CI and SI for 2 years is P(R/100)². For 3 years, it is P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).</p

questions.question: The average of all prime numbers between 32 and 69 is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

List all prime numbers between 32 and 69: 37, 41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 61, 67.

Total count of prime numbers (n) = 8.

Sum using pairing: (37+67) + (41+61) + (43+59) + (47+53) = 104 + 102 + 102 + 100 = 408.

Average = Total Sum ÷ Count = 408 ÷ 8 = 51.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Prime numbers between 32 and 69.

**Formula:** Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55520a030b2ded78bd5df95f5390ea89abb694c7c0bbbef92e2cf5dcaf3d97a9.png] 

⇒ Prime numbers between 32 and 69 are: 37, 41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 61, 67

⇒ Sum of primes = 37 + 41 + 43 + 47 + 53 + 59 + 61 + 67

⇒ Sum = 408

⇒ Total count of prime numbers = 8

⇒ Average = 408 ÷ 8

⇒ Average = 51

**∴ The correct answer is 51.**

**__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two divisors: 1 and itself. The only even prime number is 2.

Arithmetic Mean

For any set of numbers, Average = (Σx) ÷ n, where Σx is the sum of terms and n is the total number of terms.

Checking for Primes

To verify if a number N is prime, check its divisibility by prime numbers up to √N. If none divide N, then N is prime.</p

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 2 : 3 and their product is 726. The smallest number between the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of numbers = 2 : 3

Product of ratio parts = 2 × 3 = 6 units²

Value of 6 units² = 726

1 unit² = 726 ÷ 6 = 121

Multiplier (1 unit) = √121 = 11

Smallest number = 2 × 11 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio = 2 : 3, Product = 726

Formula: Product of numbers = (First Part × x) × (Second Part × x)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/994aba5e6647276452f7feaf80a63303299a4013b613cee491f653fb28ca2df9.png] 

Let the two numbers be 2x and 3x.

⇒ 2x × 3x = 726

⇒ 6x² = 726

⇒ x² = 726 ÷ 6

⇒ x² = 121

⇒ x = √121

⇒ x = 11

Smallest number = 2x

⇒ 2 × 11 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

**__Additional Information__**

Product of Ratios

When the product of two numbers in ratio a:b is given as P, the common multiplier x is found using x = √(P ÷ (a × b)).

Sum of Ratios

If the sum S is given, the multiplier x is simpler: x = S ÷ (a + b). No square root is required for sums.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by the formula √(a × b).</p

questions.question:
In the given figure, ABCD and APQR are two parallelograms. If ∠APQ = 100°, find ∠CDR. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea4fa9986e7e2ac3bd6759ddc11b0dd98cb3f211e3e93355f74c2ad839f625fc.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a parallelogram, adjacent angles are supplementary (sum = 180°).

In parallelogram APQR, ∠A + ∠P = 180° ⇒ ∠A = 180° − 100° = 80°.

In parallelogram ABCD, opposite angles are equal.

∠C = ∠A = 80°.

**∴ The correct answer is 80°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ABCD and APQR are parallelograms sharing vertex A. ∠APQ = 100°.

**Formula:** 1. Adjacent angles of a parallelogram sum to 180°. 2. Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d44b9eee8d70a7f5a2c92dba32482958a4284bd87a797f0fea4c8aaa702de1f0.png] 

In parallelogram APQR:

⇒ ∠PAR + ∠APQ = 180° (Consecutive interior angles)

⇒ ∠PAR + 100° = 180°

⇒ ∠PAR = 80°

Since A, P, B and A, R, D are collinear, ∠DAB = ∠PAR = 80°.

In parallelogram ABCD:

⇒ ∠BCD = ∠DAB (Opposite angles are equal)

⇒ ∠BCD = 80°

**∴ The correct answer is 80°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Parallelogram

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Opposite angles are equal, and any two consecutive angles are supplementary (∠A + ∠B = 180°).

Diagonals of a Parallelogram

The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, meaning they divide each other into two equal parts at the point of intersection.

Area of a Parallelogram

The area is calculated as Base × Height. If two sides a, b and the included angle θ are known, Area = a × b × sin(θ).</p

questions.question: Find the value of cos 47° sec 133° + sin 44° cosec 136°.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert obtuse angles to supplementary forms: 133° = 180° − 47° and 136° = 180° − 44°.

Using 2ⁿd quadrant rules: sec(180° − θ) = −sec θ and cosec(180° − θ) = cosec θ.

Expression = cos 47° × (−sec 47°) + sin 44° × cosec 44°.

Since cos θ × sec θ = 1 and sin θ × cosec θ = 1:

Result = −1 + 1 = 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = cos 47° sec 133° + sin 44° cosec 136°

**Formula Used:**

sec(180° − θ) = −sec θ

cosec(180° − θ) = cosec θ

cos θ × sec θ = 1

sin θ × cosec θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Split the obtuse angles into (180° − θ) form to simplify.

⇒ sec 133° = sec(180° − 47°) = −sec 47°

⇒ cosec 136° = cosec(180° − 44°) = cosec 44°

⇒ Substitute these simplified values back into the given expression.

⇒ Expression = cos 47° × (−sec 47°) + sin 44° × cosec 44°

⇒ Expression = −(cos 47° × sec 47°) + (sin 44° × cosec 44°)

⇒ Since a trigonometric function multiplied by its reciprocal is exactly 1:

⇒ Expression = −1 + 1 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

ASTC Rule

In the 2ⁿd quadrant (90° to 180°), only Sine (sin) and Cosecant (cosec) are positive. Cosine (cos), Secant (sec), Tangent (tan), and Cotangent (cot) are negative.

Reciprocal Identities

sin θ × cosec θ = 1 | cos θ × sec θ = 1 | tan θ × cot θ = 1.

Supplementary Angles

Angles that add up to 180° are supplementary. sin(180° − θ) = sin θ, while cos(180° − θ) = −cos θ.
</p

questions.question: What is the sum of all the exterior angles taken in order of a triangle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of the exterior angles of any convex polygon, including a triangle, taken in order is always a constant 360°.

This is because walking around the exterior of any closed shape and returning to the starting direction completes exactly one full circle.

One full circle rotation is equivalent to 360°.

**∴ The correct answer is 360°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: A triangle with internal angles A, B, and C.

Formula Used: Exterior angle + Interior angle = 180° (Linear Pair); Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4d4db5abaa1583953ae0faf40bed332e9b71000a00d768c9cca85db13d109c.png] 

⇒ Let the three interior angles be A, B, and C.

⇒ We know that A + B + C = 180°.

⇒ Exterior angle at vertex A = 180° − A.

⇒ Exterior angle at vertex B = 180° − B.

⇒ Exterior angle at vertex C = 180° − C.

⇒ Sum of exterior angles = (180° − A) + (180° − B) + (180° − C).

⇒ Sum = (180° + 180° + 180°) − (A + B + C).

⇒ Sum = 540° − 180°.

⇒ Sum = 360°.

**∴ The correct answer is 360°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Exterior Angles

For any convex polygon with n sides, the sum of its exterior angles (one at each vertex) is always 360°.

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of the interior angles of a polygon with n sides is calculated as (n − 2) × 180°.

Triangle Exterior Angle Property

An exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles of the triangle.

Regular Polygons

In a regular polygon, each exterior angle is equal to 360° ÷ n, where n is the number of sides.</p

questions.question: A rectangular plot of grass is 80m long and 60 m broad. From the centre of each side a path of 3 metre wide goes across the centre of the opposite side. What is the area of these paths?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Area of two paths crossing at the center is given by the formula: Area = w(L + B − w).

Where w = width of path, L = length, B = breadth.

Given: L = 80 m, B = 60 m, w = 3 m.

Area = 3 × (80 + 60 − 3) = 3 × 137 = 411 sqm.

**∴ The correct answer is 411 sqm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the rectangular plot (L) = 80 m

Breadth of the rectangular plot (B) = 60 m

Width of each path (w) = 3 m

**Formula Used:**

Total Area of paths = (Area of horizontal path) + (Area of vertical path) − (Area of common intersection)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7a464a72d188ed683031b96348f9b0a4c7653747e4c5c26fce3d0706a67d68b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the path parallel to the length = 80 m × 3 m = 240 sqm

⇒ Area of the path parallel to the breadth = 60 m × 3 m = 180 sqm

⇒ Area of the common square at the center = 3 m × 3 m = 9 sqm

⇒ Total Area of paths = 240 + 180 − 9

⇒ Total Area = 420 − 9 = 411 sqm

**∴ The correct answer is 411 sqm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Path Around Outside of Rectangle

Area of a path of width 'w' running outside a rectangle of length L and breadth B = 2w(L + B + 2w).

Path Inside the Rectangle

Area of a path of width 'w' running inside the boundary of a rectangle = 2w(L + B − 2w).

General Path Area Concept

When paths cross, the intersection area must be subtracted once because it is calculated twice in the individual path areas.</p

questions.question: A cylindrical tank of radius 14 cm is full of water. If 616 litres of water are drawn out, then the water level in the tank is dropped by ______ m. (Take π = (22/7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Drop in height (h) = Volume ÷ Base Area = V ÷ πr²

⇒ h = (616 × 1000) ÷ ((22/7) × 14 × 14) cm

⇒ h = 616000 ÷ 616 = 1000 cm

⇒ h = 10 m

**∴ The correct answer is 10 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the cylindrical tank, r = 14 cm

Volume of water drawn out, V = 616 litres

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

1 Litre = 1000 cm³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/868ecac0e39d366d76031c0cbdf523119dc00c6313d3653d08f1836c12541f22.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the drop in water level be h.

⇒ Volume drawn out = 616 × 1000 = 616000 cm³

⇒ V = πr²h

⇒ 616000 = (22/7) × 14 × 14 × h

⇒ 616000 = 22 × 2 × 14 × h

⇒ 616000 = 616 × h

⇒ h = 616000 ÷ 616

⇒ h = 1000 cm

⇒ Since 1 m = 100 cm, h = 1000 ÷ 100 = 10 m

**∴ The correct answer is 10 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Formulas

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r+h).

Volume Conversions

1 Litre = 1000 cm³ | 1 m³ = 1000 Litres | 1 m³ = 10⁶ cm³.

Direct Proportion in Cylinders

For a uniform cross-section tank, the volume drawn or added is directly proportional to the change in height (ΔV = Base Area × Δh).
</p

questions.question: The angle of elevation of a cloud from a point 200 m above a lake is 30° and the angle of depression of its reflection in the lake is 60°. The height of the cloud is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Shortcut formula for cloud height: h = H × (tan β + tan α) ÷ (tan β − tan α)

Where H = height of observation point = 200 m, α = elevation = 30°, β = depression = 60°.

h = 200 × (tan 60° + tan 30°) ÷ (tan 60° − tan 30°)

h = 200 × (√3 + 1/√3) ÷ (√3 − 1/√3) = 200 × (4/√3) ÷ (2/√3) = 200 × 2 = 400 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 400 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of observer (H) = 200 m above lake surface.

Angle of elevation of cloud (α) = 30°.

Angle of depression of reflection (β) = 60°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a20210bbae0926b1c58d150e22a2b0406603b9cc858dca8bfe0df5f98ba5533.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let h be the height of the cloud above the lake surface.

The reflection is at depth h below the lake surface.

Let d be the horizontal distance from the observation point to the cloud.

⇒ Height of cloud above point = h − 200

⇒ tan 30° = (h − 200) ÷ d

⇒ d = (h − 200) × √3 ... (1)

⇒ Depth of reflection below point = h + 200

⇒ tan 60° = (h + 200) ÷ d

⇒ d = (h + 200) ÷ √3 ... (2)

⇒ From (1) and (2): (h − 200) × √3 = (h + 200) ÷ √3

⇒ 3 × (h − 200) = h + 200

⇒ 3h − 600 = h + 200

⇒ 2h = 800

⇒ h = 400 m

**∴ The correct answer is 400 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reflection Property

In a calm lake, the lake surface acts as a plane mirror. The height of the object above the lake is always equal to the depth of its reflection below the lake surface.

Standard Trigonometric Values

For height and distance problems, remember: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, and tan 60° = √3.

General Formula for Cloud Height

If elevation is α and depression is β from height H, then h = H(sin(β+α)/sin(β−α)). Applying this to 60° and 30° gives h = H(sin 90°/sin 30°) = H(1/(1/2)) = 2H.</p

questions.question: The sum of digits of a two digit number is 8 and the difference between the number and that formed by reversing the digits is 18. What is the difference between the digits of the number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference between a two-digit number and its reverse is always 9 × (Difference between the digits).

Given that the difference between the numbers is 18.

9 × (Difference between digits) = 18

Difference between digits = 18 ÷ 9 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of digits (x + y) = 8

Difference between number and its reverse = 18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e66b8a142cf2f8632ea37a1fd0f0ae743012e24b1236995fba8753b269d4887d.png] 

⇒ Let the tens digit be x and units digit be y.

⇒ The two-digit number = 10x + y

⇒ Number formed by reversing digits = 10y + x

⇒ According to the problem: (10x + y) − (10y + x) = 18

⇒ 10x − x + y − 10y = 18

⇒ 9x − 9y = 18

⇒ 9(x − y) = 18

⇒ x − y = 18 ÷ 9

⇒ x − y = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Number and its Reverse

The sum of a two-digit number and its reverse is always a multiple of 11. Formula: (10x + y) + (10y + x) = 11(x + y).

Three Digit Number Reverse

The difference between a three-digit number (abc) and its reverse (cba) is always 99 × (a − c). Formula: (100a + 10b + c) − (100c + 10b + a) = 99(a − c).

Digit Sum Logic

To find individual digits, use the system: x + y = Sum, x − y = Difference. Then x = (Sum + Diff) ÷ 2 and y = (Sum − Diff) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: The marked price of a jacket is Rs. 3,500. A shopkeeper offers 5% discount on it and then again offers 15% discount on the new price, and then again offers 20% discount on the new price. How much one has to pay for it?

Marked Price (MP) of jacket = Rs. 3,500

Successive discounts = 5%, 15%, and 20%

**Calculations:**

⇒ SP = 3500 × 19/20 × 17/20 × 4/5

Marked Price (MP)

The marked price is the regular price tag printed on an item. Any discount given by a shopkeeper is always calculated on the MP, not the cost price.

Successive Discount Formula

When an article has multiple consecutive discounts, the net selling price is derived by multiplying the individual discount factors: SP = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × ...

Equivalent Single Discount

For two successive discounts of x% and y%, the effective single discount equivalent to both combined is calculated using the net change formula: (x + y − xy/100)%.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 9,350 was taken as a loan. This is paid in two equal instalments. If the rate of interest is 20% per annum compounded annually, then what is the value of each instalment?(approximately)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate 20% = 1/5 → Principal : Installment ratio for 1st year = 5 : 6

For 2nd year, square the ratios → Principal : Installment = 5² : 6² = 25 : 36

Equalize installments: Multiply 1st year ratio by 6 → (5 × 6) : (6 × 6) = 30 : 36

Total Principal units = 30 + 25 = 55 units

55 units = ₹9350 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹170

Value of each installment = 36 units = 36 × 170 = ₹6120

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Loan Amount (P) = ₹9350

Rate of Interest (R) = 20% per annum

Number of installments (n) = 2

**Formula Used:**

P = [x / (1 + R/100)¹] + [x / (1 + R/100)²] + ... where x is the equal installment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aedae0e0b60f0f28ff07359e851dee86c069fcf01ba6c7b8e667faa7761abab5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 9350 = x / (1 + 20/100) + x / (1 + 20/100)²

⇒ 9350 = x / (1.2) + x / (1.44)

⇒ 9350 = x / (6/5) + x / (36/25)

⇒ 9350 = 5x/6 + 25x/36

⇒ 9350 = (30x + 25x) / 36

⇒ 9350 = 55x / 36

⇒ x = (9350 × 36) / 55

⇒ x = 170 × 36

⇒ x = ₹6120

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

CI Installment General Formula

For n equal installments, P = x[1/(1+r) + 1/(1+r)² + ... + 1/(1+r)ⁿ], where r is the rate per period in decimal.

SI vs CI Installments

In CI installments, interest is charged on the reducing balance (present value), whereas SI installments often involve interest on the total amount or specific due balances.

Effective Rate of Interest

If compounded half-yearly, the rate is halved (R/2) and the number of periods is doubled (2n) in the installment formula.

questions.question: If 20% of a number is (1/6)th of another number, what is the ratio of first number to the second number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentage to fraction: 20% = 1/5.

According to the question: (1/5) × First Number = (1/6) × Second Number.

Cross-multiply to find the ratio: First Number / Second Number = 5 / 6.

Ratio = 5 : 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the first number be 'x' and the second number be 'y'.

20% of x = (1/6) of y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57f0f82a10c02b9e2ab06e0aa4be46e1cea5c99e808bee558dccf36929060f4d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 20% of x = (1/6) × y

⇒ (20 / 100) × x = (1 / 6) × y

⇒ (1 / 5) × x = (1 / 6) × y

⇒ x / y = (1 / 6) ÷ (1 / 5)

⇒ x / y = (1 / 6) × (5 / 1)

⇒ x / y = 5 / 6

⇒ x : y = 5 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide by 100 and simplify. Example: 20% = 20/100 = 1/5; 25% = 1/4; 50% = 1/2.

Ratio and Proportion

If a × A = b × B, then the ratio A : B is equal to the inverse of the coefficients, which is (1/a) : (1/b) or simply b : a.

Cross-Multiplication Rule

In the equation x/a = y/b, the ratio x : y can be directly found as a : b by rearranging the terms.</p

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 6 years.

Total Amount (A)

questions.question: The age of some students is given in years as 12, 13, 16, 18,14, 19, 13, 17, 15 and 11. The median age (in years) of the students is:

Arrange the given data in ascending order: 11, 12, 13, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19.

questions.question: What is the value of ({k}+(1)/(k))({k}-(1)/({k)})({k}²+(1)/({k)²})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴})?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the iterative use of the identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Each product doubles the power of the variables and keeps the − sign.

The sequence of powers is: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8.

The final simplified form will be the square of the highest power terms in the last pair with a minus sign.

**∴ The correct answer is k⁸ − 1/k⁸.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given Expression: (k + 1/k)(k − 1/k)(k² + 1/k²)(k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

Formula Used: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

⇒ [(k + 1/k)(k − 1/k)] × (k² + 1/k²) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k² − 1/k²) × (k² + 1/k²) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ [(k² − 1/k²)(k² + 1/k²)] × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k⁴ − 1/k⁴) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k⁴)² − (1/k⁴)²

⇒ k⁸ − 1/k⁸

**∴ The correct answer is k⁸ − 1/k⁸.**

**__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares

The identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b² is fundamental for simplifying algebraic products involving conjugate pairs.

General Power Rule

For an expression of the form (x − y)(x + y)(x² + y²)(x⁴ + y⁴)...(x²ⁿ−¹ + y²ⁿ−¹), the simplified result is x²ⁿ − y²ⁿ.

Cubic Identities

Sum of cubes: (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) = a³ + b³ and Difference of cubes: (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) = a³ − b³.</p

questions.question: A sum of money doubled itself at certain rate of compound interest in 15 years. In how many years will it become four times of itself?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In Compound Interest, if a sum becomes n times in t years, it becomes nk times in k × t years.

Given: A sum doubles (n = 2) in t = 15 years.

Target: 4 times of itself → 4 = 2², so k = 2.

Required time = k × t = 2 × 15 = 30 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time (t₁) = 15 years

Growth = Doubled (2 times)

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)t

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/395447a344da580aafadb4979cc91422ac4c1686408d3201aad34cb1e23da18f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2P = P(1 + r/100)¹⁵

⇒ 2 = (1 + r/100)¹⁵ --- (Equation 1)

⇒ Let the required time be T years to become 4 times.

⇒ 4P = P(1 + r/100)T

⇒ 4 = (1 + r/100)T

⇒ 2² = (1 + r/100)T

⇒ Substituting value of 2 from Eq.1:

⇒ [(1 + r/100)¹⁵]² = (1 + r/100)T

⇒ (1 + r/100)³⁰ = (1 + r/100)T

⇒ T = 30 years

**∴ The correct answer is 30 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Amount Formula

The total amount A is given by A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where P is the principal, R is the rate of interest per annum, and n is the number of years.

Successive Multiplication in CI

In Compound Interest, the sum of money increases in a Geometric Progression (GP) where the amount becomes n times in a fixed interval of time.

Rule of 72

To find the approximate time needed to double the money at compound interest, divide 72 by the annual interest rate (Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate).</p

questions.question: Anil sells a table to Kamal at a profit of 10% and Kamal sells it to Rajat at a profit of 12%. If Rajat pays ₹246.40 for it, then how much had Anil paid for it?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Anil to Kamal profit = 10% → Ratio = 10 : 11

Kamal to Rajat profit = 12% → Ratio = 25 : 28

Successive Ratio (Anil : Rajat) = (10 × 25) : (11 × 28) = 250 : 308

308 units = ₹246.40 ⇒ 1 unit = 0.8

Anil CP = 250 units × 0.8 = ₹200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹200.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Anil profit = 10%

Kamal profit = 12%

Rajat payment (Final SP) = ₹246.40

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbcb464918566798a9254cdc8e6ea0e120768530495e181e75b223c57a946171.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the cost price for Anil be ₹ x.

⇒ Price paid by Kamal = x × (100 + 10) ÷ 100 = 1.1x

⇒ Price paid by Rajat = 1.1x × (100 + 12) ÷ 100

⇒ 246.40 = 1.1x × 1.12

⇒ 246.40 = 1.232x

⇒ x = 246.40 ÷ 1.232

⇒ x = 200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹200.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value changes by a% and then by b%, the effective change is [a + b + (a × b)/100] %.

Chain Selling Formula

Final Price = Initial CP × (100 ± P₁/L₁)/100 × (100 ± P₂/L₂)/100 × ...

Cost Price Calculation

CP = [SP ÷ (100 + Profit %)] × 100 or CP = [SP ÷ (100 − Loss %)] × 100.

questions.question: The speed of a boat down the stream is 125% of the speed in still water. If the boat takes 30 minutes to cover 20 km in still water, then how much time (in hours) will it take to cover 15 km upstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio Downstream : Still water = 125% : 100% = 5 : 4

Stream speed ratio = 5 − 4 = 1 part, so Upstream speed ratio = 4 − 1 = 3 parts.

Speed in still water (4 parts) = 20 km ÷ 0.5 hr = 40 km/h.

Upstream speed (3 parts) = (40 ÷ 4) × 3 = 30 km/h.

Time for 15 km upstream = 15 ÷ 30 = 1/2 hour.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/2 hour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Speed downstream = 125% of speed in still water.

⇒ Time taken to cover 20 km in still water = 30 minutes = 0.5 hours.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Speed = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = Boat Speed (B) + Stream Speed (S)

⇒ Upstream Speed (U) = Boat Speed (B) − Stream Speed (S)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3c23fec93def93e6ddefbd76678ec1169c82b5e14d8bcb2559847494062b6e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed in still water (B) = 20 km ÷ 0.5 hours = 40 km/h

⇒ Speed downstream (D) = 125% of 40 = 1.25 × 40 = 50 km/h

⇒ Speed of stream (S) = D − B = 50 − 40 = 10 km/h

⇒ Speed upstream (U) = B − S = 40 − 10 = 30 km/h

⇒ Time to cover 15 km upstream = Distance ÷ Upstream Speed

⇒ Time = 15 ÷ 30 = 1/2 hour

**∴ The correct answer is 1/2 hour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed in Still Water

It is the average of downstream and upstream speeds: B = (D + U) ÷ 2

Speed of Stream

It is half the difference between downstream and upstream speeds: S = (D − U) ÷ 2

Average Speed of Journey

If a boat goes a certain distance downstream and comes back upstream, the average speed is (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).
</p

questions.question:
Which of the following is/are prime numbers?

(i) 241 

(ii) 337

(iii) 391

(iv) 571
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To check if n is prime, test its divisibility by primes p ≤ √n.

(i) √241 ≈ 15.5: Not divisible by primes 7, 11, or 13 → Prime.

(ii) √337 ≈ 18.3: Not divisible by primes 7, 11, 13, or 17 → Prime.

(iii) 391 ÷ 17 = 23 → Composite; (iv) √571 ≈ 23.9: No prime factors ≤ 23 → Prime.

**∴ The correct answer is (i), (ii) and (iv).**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given numbers: (i) 241, (ii) 337, (iii) 391, (iv) 571.

Method: A number is prime if it is not divisible by any prime number less than or equal to its square root.

⇒ For 241: √241 ≈ 15.5. Primes to check: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13. Divisibility check: 241 ÷ 7 = 34.4, 241 ÷ 11 = 21.9, 241 ÷ 13 = 18.5. No factors found, so 241 is Prime.

⇒ For 337: √337 ≈ 18.3. Primes: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17. Divisibility check: 337 ÷ 13 = 25.9, 337 ÷ 17 = 19.8. No factors found, so 337 is Prime.

⇒ For 391: √391 ≈ 19.7. Primes up to 19: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19. Checking divisibility: 391 ÷ 17 = 23. Since 17 is a factor, 391 is Composite.

**__Additional Information__**

Prime and Composite Numbers

A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two factors: 1 and itself. A composite number has more than two factors. 1 is neither prime nor composite.

Even Prime Number

2 is the smallest prime number and the only even prime number in the entire number system.

Square Root Rule for Primality

To check if a number N is prime, we only need to test its divisibility by prime numbers up to √N. If no prime factor is found in this range, the number is prime.</p
